item.title: Oyasukyo Gorge: Akita's Steaming Onsen Ravine — Guide
item.description: Oyasukyo Gorge in Yuzawa is a steep, dramatic ravine where jets of scalding steam and hot water hiss straight from the cliff faces — a raw display of the region’s volcanic energy. A riverside walkway lets you feel the heat up close, and it’s at its most spectacular among the fiery maples of mid-to-late October. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Yuzawa, Akita Hours Walkway daytime (best autumn) Admission Free Time needed About 1 hour Best time Mid–late October (autumn) What to See Jets of scalding steam hissing from the cliffs.
